title: Period 3 oxides in water
caption: Across period 3 the oxides change from basic to acidic. Na₂O and MgO give alkaline solutions; Al₂O₃ and SiO₂ do not dissolve (Al₂O₃ is amphoteric); P₄O₁₀ and SO₃ react to give strongly acidic solutions. Typical pH values.
alt: Bar chart of the typical pH when each period 3 oxide is added to water: Na₂O 14, MgO 9, Al₂O₃ 7, SiO₂ 7, P₄O₁₀ 0, SO₃ 0.
description: P₄O₁₀ and SO₃: about pH 0 (H₃PO₄ and H₂SO₄ form).
